# Dividend curve (`dividend-curve` v1)

Expected dividends by year (implied from dividend futures and forwards).

**Group:** Market data · **Mnemonic:** `DIV` · **Identifiers:** `DIV-…` in `curveId`

Open one with `DIV <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: dividend-curve
version: 1
description: Expected dividends by year (implied from dividend futures and forwards).
match: { kind: dividend-curve, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Market data · Dividend curve, id: $.curveId }
strip:
  - { label: Underlier, bind: $.underlier }
  - { label: Yield, bind: $.dividendYield, fmt: pct2, emphasis: true }
panels:
  - id: divs
    kind: hbar
    title: Expected dividends
    key: F2
    rows: $.points
    label: year
    value: amount
    fmt: price2
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.underlyingEquity, 'equity')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
